subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Context-free calculations to 10
source.subtopic: Addition and subtraction up to 6 (weeks 1-2), 7 (weeks 3-4), 8 (weeks 5-6), 9 (weeks 7-8) and 10 (weeks 9-10) using +, -, =, □

show.line: Ten fingers! Seven up and three down. Seven plus three equals ten. Let's work to ten.

rounds.prompt: Six plus four. Tap the answer.
Five birds and three more land. How many birds now?
Ten minus two. How many are left? Say the number.
Nine minus five. Tap the answer.
Eight plus the box equals ten. What goes in the box?
rounds.praise: Two! Eight plus two equals ten.

rounds.story: Ten children play. Four go home. How many children still play?

rounds.prompt: Does it make ten? Sort the sums.

hints: Start with the bigger number and count on.
Use all ten fingers. Fold some down to take away.

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Seven plus three equals ten.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count on from seven. Eight, nine, ten!

parent_line: Can add and subtract with numbers up to 10.
